subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as synonym for the underlined word.

The most __arrogant__ employee in his company was sacked by the boss. No one could tolerate his _________ nature.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Haughty'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Arrogant', **which describes someone having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.** (अहंकारी).**

 
 
• **Example: **Her **arrogant **behavior towards her colleagues creates problems in the office.
 
 
 
• **'Haughty',** implying a disdainful, excessively proud and contemptuous attitude. **(घमंडी)**.
 
 
• **Example: **His **haughty** attitude made it hard for others to work with him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Pricey'** refers to something that is very costly or expensive. **(महंगा).**
 
• **'Plain'** indicates simplicity, clarity, or obviousness. **(सरल) or (स्पष्ट)**.
 
• **'Dicey' **suggests uncertainty or unpredictability. **(अनिश्चित).**
